title: List growth media (for pagination)
description: List growth media with registered strain and species counts and pH as recorded in TogoMedium.

sort.description: Use strain_count to sort by the number of associated strains. Leave empty to preserve unspecified ordering.

order.description: Sort direction: asc or desc. Applies when sort is strain_count.

limit.description: Maximum number of media rows to return.

offset.description: Number of media rows to skip.
